scope: Isolated retrospective bank-model replay on derived data from exact recovered FDIC bytes; no promotion or point-in-time claim
limitations: Current revised data; original publication timestamps/vintages unavailable. Retrospective pilot, not a point-in-time early-warning claim.
32 current large surviving banks; survivorship bias and limited relevance to smaller SME banks.
Previous-year SOD availability proxy; actual historical publication dates unverified.
Geographic overlap is similarity, not proof of causal contagion.
Treasury rates are context only, not model features.
